messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

This swelling is known as peripheral edema.
The swelling may add to weight changes.
The swelling becomes more common with age.
Triplet: ["Gabapentin", "has incidence rate", "2 in 100"]

The relation 'has incidence rate' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug or condition occurs at the specified frequency in the object.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has side effect frequency': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect specified by the object entity with the frequency indicated.
B. 'may be used for': The subject drug may be used for the purpose or condition specified by the object entity.
C. 'related to': The subject drug is associated with the medical condition or disease specified by the object entity.
D. 'used after': The subject drug is used following the treatment or condition specified by the object entity.
E. 'has administration instruction': The subject drug should be taken or used in the manner specified by the object entity (for example with food or at a fixed time).
